tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byad 'grol gser lde'i chog khrigs man ngag nying khu bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra kro dhā ya/ rgyal kun mthu stobs rdo rje 'bar ba'i mes/ /ma lus bdud sde'i bud shing kun bsregs nas/ /ye shes mchog gi snang ba rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma khrag 'thung rdo rje gtsug tor rgyal/ /rnam mkhyen sku bzhir 'jug sgo lus ngag yid/ /phas rgol rigs sngags dmod pas dam 'khyud lcags/ /'grol byed zab don gser gyi lde mig gis/ /'byed mkhas mchog gi rgyu thabs 'di kho na/ /'dir gnam lcags sdigs pa'i chos kyi sde'i 'phrin las kyi sbyor ba shin tu zab cing rno ba byad 'grol gser gyi lde mig nyams su len pa la gnyis/ rang don du bsnyen pa bya ba dang / gzhan don du bum sgrub kyi cho ga bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas khang byi dor byas par rang gi g.yas su rtsa ba gsum gyi sku gsung thugs rten gang 'byor dang / lhag tu slob dpon chen po'i sku byin can nam/ de min rab gnas dang ldan pa'i sku bzhugs/ de'i drung stegs bu khebs ldan 'bru bkram pa la dpal gtor snying gzugs la mtheb dkyus bskor ba/ g.yas su sman/ g.yon du rak+ta/ mdun du chu gnyis nyer mchod sbrengs tshar/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril me tog la sogs kyang 'du byas la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar bsam la 'og gi mchod sngags rnams 'bru gsum gyis spel ba brjod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas tshogs zhing du spyan drangs/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la/

/gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum pa yi chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rangs/ /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dgos pa gsum gyis lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam/ hūm̐/ chos kun ma bcos gdod nas spros bral dbyings/ /ma rtogs 'gro la mkha' khyab snying rjer shar/ /zung 'jug rig pa mthing nag yi ge hūm̐/ /de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas sras bcas mchod/ /phas rgol rig sngags dmod pa'i sbyor ba bshig /byin rlabs dngos grub dwangs bcud hūm̐ la thim/ /de nyid yongs gyur pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /bdag nyid khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor can/ /dbu stong rtsa zhal nyis brgya mthing nag rngams/ /g.yas zhal nyis brgya gser mdog 'dzum nyams rgyas/ /rgyab zhal nyis brgya dmar po chags pa'i nyams/ /g.yon zhal nyis brgya ljang gu gtum pa'i tshul/ /steng zhal nyis brgya dkar po bzhad pa'i zhal/ /stong phrag phyag ldan bye ba phrag brgya'i spyan/ /dmar zlum sdang mig phyogs bcur kun tu blta/ /rdzi smin ag tshom dmar ser me ltar 'bar/ /zhal gdangs ya so hūm̐ las khro bo bcu/ ma so hrīḥlas khro mo bcu ru gtsigs/ /mgrin pa nyi zla lce ni gcod byed kyi/ /rno ngar ral gri 'bar ba'i rnam par gdangs/ /stong phyag phyag na gnam lcags ral gri bsnams/ /thod skam dbu brgyan zhing glang stod g.yogs dang / /stag sham mgo phreng dur khrod rgyan chas brjid/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'dor stabs drag por bsgrad/ /gar dgu'i nyams rgyas dbang sngon lhun po la/

/nyi ma stong gis 'khyud bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs/ /de'i spyi bor zla steng oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar āḥ snying khar nyi dkyil hūm̐ sngon mtshan pa las/ /'od 'phros rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs bskul/ /spyan drangs yi ge gsum la thim pa yis/ /rim bzhin rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin/ /snang mtha' dmar po g.yas pa pad+ma 'dzin/ /mi bskyod mthing ga g.yas pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun kyang g.yon pa dril 'dzin longs sku'i chas/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar sku gsung thugs byin brlabs/ /de yi spyi bor zhes pa man gyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul 'di ni rtsa ba'i gzhung gi tshig zin dngos su yod par ma zad/ snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi lha bskyed kyi mngon rtogs rnams dang babs mthun pas 'thad par sems so/ /rig 'dzin rje'i yig cha ltar na/ de yi spyi mgrin snying lte gsang gnas lngar/ /rnam snang 'od dpag med mgon mi bskyod pa/ /rin 'byung don grub lnga ka khrag 'thung tshul/ /g.yas pas rang rtags g.yon pas dung khrag 'dzin/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan 'bar ba'i stabs su bzhugs/ /zhes sbyar/ de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las/ /'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs gyur/ /hūm̐/ dmigs med mkha' ltar khyab cing dag pa'i sku/ /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba mi dmigs kyang / /thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos sku dag pa las/ /ye shes sgyu mar rol cing gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /dam tshig bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar dang / ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/

ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i rnam rol las/ /rig sngags dmod pa phyir bzlog drag po'i lhar/ /rnam rol rdo rje khrag 'thung gtsug tor can/ /'jigs byed 'jigs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod/ de nas bzlas dmigs ni/ bdag gi sku yi cha las 'bar ba'i me/ /sngags kyi tsha tsha rdo rje'i zhugs su 'phro/ /gnod byed phas rgol rig sngags byad ma mkhan/ /thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs nas stong par gyur/ /zhes ting nge 'dzin gyi nga rgyal drag po dang ldan pas/ rgya gar skad du/ bha ra u sha tsakra nā ma/ bod skad du/ ngag 'grol ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐ rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo: phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo: dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo: spyan bye ba brgya phrag 'bum mnga' ba: me lce 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can: rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma: kun nas bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la nyin dang mtshan du bsrung du gsol: hūm̐/ khro bo'i rgyal po ngag dang byad 'grol ba rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo: gang dag bdag la mi phan par 'dod pa dang : rnam par sdang ba dang : gnod par sems pa dang : ngan sngags byed pa dang : byed du bcug pa dang : gtad byed pa dang : khram la 'debs pa dang : rbod gtong byed pa dang : sbyin sreg byed pa dang : mnan pa dang : bcings pa dang : ngag mnan pa dang : dmod mo byed pa dang : hom dang spar bu bskor ba dang : rlung nag 'khrug pas bskor ba dang : steng lha yis bcings pa dang : 'og klu yis bcings pa dang : bar lha srin sde brgyad kyis bcings pa dang : phra men gyis bcings pa dang : phra men gyis byad du bcug nas bdag cag rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa thams cad rnam par gzhig tu gsol lo: rnam par gzhom du gsol lo:

lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa khrol du gsol lo: nges par khrol du gsol lo: tad+ya thā: oṃ a na le a na le: bhi sha dhe bhi sha dhe: bai ra bai ra: badz+ra dha ra ṇi: bhan+dha bhan+dha ni: badz+ra pa ṇi phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ hūm̐ bh+rūṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha phaṭa swāhā: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha ya/ hu lu hu lu: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha: bhan+dha bhan+dha: ha na ha na: a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byad du bcug pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ hri badz+ra bud+dha r+dharma/ saṅgha kirti sarba karma/ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā: na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ shes pa rin ta ho: he si ti sa ma ya: du she pra ti bya ba lo ki tra swāhā: oṃ badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la sarba karma badz+ra bhin dha ya: ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ma ma sarba bhin+dha bhin+dha dza re bi dza ye: ma ma badz+ra sarba u tsit+ta: a pa ra tsit+ta: ma ra byer byer: pra ma dha ye ma ma hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ shān+tiṃ ka ri ni ye ma ma badz+ra dz+nyā na pra yats+tsha ma ma bhi dha ra ya: ha ha: hi hi: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: pra ga ra na pañca la swāhā: karma badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ oṃ oṃ bud+dha kirti: dhu ru dhu ru: lus kyi dbang po phye phye khrol khrol: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: oṃ oṃ oṃ phaṭa: ā ā āḥ dharma kirti: dhu ru dhu ru: ngag gi dbang po phye phye khrol khrol: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: ā ā ā phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: saṅgha kirti: dhu ru dhu ru: yid kyi dbang po thongs cig phye phye khrol khrol: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yaṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: baṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: raṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: laṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ: shud+dhe shud+dhe: a a ā swāhā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ shang shang hūm̐: tri hri mā ra ya phaṭa: thum khrol shang shang swāhā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ dhe ba nag po bdag la rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ nag po ti ta bag tu phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ dhe ba tsan tra ghan dhi ghan dhi: kha shi na kha shi na/ badz+ra badz+ra so ri so ri: tsu ru tsu ru: u li u li: mu tra mu tra: mu tra ya: ma hā bhe ra bha man tra sarba: lo ke swāhā: ban dgra a mu ka tsa sbur srog nan: snying la gzer phreng shag yaṃ rbad: e hur thum dza: kham shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya: bdag la ngan sngags kyi gnod pa byas pa thams cad shig cig phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra tri ga dza phaṭa: shig phyung sarba sha truṃ: a ta ha ra swā hā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā: bcings pa'i rigs thams cad sarba a pa na ye swāhā: oṃ badz+ra ka ya gling bzlog: lus bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra hi baṃ garba ya bzlog: ngag bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra hi ga nan bzlog: yid bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa thams cad sarba a pa na ye swāhā/ oṃ phra men ma mu ru su phye phye khrol khrol: pa ta staṃ pa ya phye phye khrol khrol: pra ti staṃ pa ya phye phye khrol khrol: mu kha staṃ pa ya phye phye khrol khrol: ku ru staṃ pa ya phye phye khrol khrol: mo ha staṃ pa ya phye phye khrol khrol: shud+dha ni staṃ pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ ha ku shaṃ shaṃ phye phye khrol khrol:

bha ta li phye phye khrol khrol: bha ra li phye phye khrol khrol: bha kha mu khi phye phye khrol khrol: sarba duṣ+ṭan phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ e ka pa taṃ nan: mu stegs kyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: bzlog bh+yo/ te tsu he te ma/ tsu te tsu/ tsu te ke ra/ bhi bhi hā ma te/ ka bi te de ba bha mo/ na li tsi te/ bha ke li ta ka hūm̐/ mu stegs sprel lag can gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: bdag gi mi nor zhing khang la gnod pa'i rigs thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: lus ngag yid gsum la phra men gyi rigs thams cad kyis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ban dgra u mu ga du raṃ tri/ yaṃ tri/ dh+rid phyung srog gzir nan phyung : ai hur thum dza: khaṃ shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya zug pa thon thon phyung phyung phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ shud+dha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra dhu ma gha ta ye ngan sngags kyi dbal sod/ na ma swāhā/ badz+ra bha ra hi/ kro ti ka li/ ha ri ni pa/ a be sha ya/ ha badz+ra ḍā ki ni/ ri rat+na ḍā ki ni/ ni pad+ma ḍā ki ni/ pa karma ḍā ki ni/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ngag mnan gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ya ma tha/ ya rak+ṣa tsa pa tri phu ni na ni/ a phye phye/ a shig shig a khrol khrol/ dza ni pi ni/ 'bri yal yal byer/ ha ri dha pa tra phye phye/ traṃ pa ta hri ha byi na yal yal/ 'bri ni bh+yo/ pi ni dza/ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: kī la ya bdag la srungs shig rak+ṣa: ra tsa bdag la srungs shig rak+ṣa: ma hā srungs shig rak+ṣa: nā ga srungs shig rak+ṣa: ya ma srungs shig rak+ṣa: badz+ra srungs shig rak+ṣa: du tri srungs shig rak+ṣa: ga'u srungs shig rak+ṣa: phu tri srungs shig rak+ṣa: pu tri srungs shig rak+ṣa: du yag srungs shig rak+ṣa: dz+wa la dhe ba srungs shig rak+ṣa:

ka pa bha ga ha du sha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ a ya ma du nā ga tsa tri she/ dpe la/ oṃ so nag po ri pa tsa ya na ga ra sha 'dug raṃ raṃ raṃ tsa ma ri phyung na ga phu mā ra ya/ khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ tsa ma ri phyung nā ga phu mā ra ya/ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ tsa ma ri phyung nā ga phu mā ra ya/ laṃ laṃ laṃ tsa ma ri phyung nā ga phu mā ra ya/ oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gtad khram zhi bar gyur cig shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes klu'i byad 'grol ba'i sngags 'di dbus gtsang gi par ma sogs dpe phal cher la mi 'dug kyang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zhus dag gnang ba der 'byung ba bzhin smin grol gling gdung brgyud rin po cher bka' 'dri zhus par yang ma chad pa dgos tshul byung / oṃ ma hā de ba shrī ral pa can khaṃ khaṃ tshig tshig e e laṃ laṃ yaṃ yaṃ baṃ baṃ raṃ raṃ/ paṃ paṃ/ rbad bh+yo/ man tra gu h+ya thing thing khri/ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan ma hā de ba u ma de bi dbang phyug yab yum gyis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ya ma ra tsa ma ma ru lu gshin rje dang ma mo'i bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: e ka dza ṭi ma mo e ka dza ṭis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ru tra dun ti bdud pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: shu la tsa rā dza btsan dang rgyal pos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: pa hā ga nā ga kro ti shwa ri/ klu pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: yak+ṣa yag mo gnod sbyin pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: pa sha mi gi dhe wa a gza' dang yul lhas bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: tir ti ka mu stegs pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: rak+ṣa rag mo/ srin po pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrolaḥ mun mun pa dmu yis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: badz+ra pa du pa tra/ haṃ shaṃ tri ru tri tri/ rdo rje legs pa dang 'gong po the'u rang gis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol:

dza du tri raṃ ma baṃ ril/ brag srin ma dang srin mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ging ka ra yaṃ tri/ ging dang ru tras bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ma hā ka la a pe la/ mgon po dang a byis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: teg na 'dre rum/ yul 'dre pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: tri pa shaṃ ling byi na ya ka bgegs pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ḍā ki ni/ mkha' 'gro mas bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: sarba hring hring dzaḥ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: shi ta ra ra phu phu ru ru phu phu/ te ba ta pa shi su ga ta pa shi phu/ hal khyi nag pos lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ bag sha ya badz+ra badz+ri dzi ta ya/ kha shan ting shag shag byer byer yal yal/ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ ma la yag pa byer/ 'jam pa byer/ ya bzlog bh+yo: e ka yak+ṣa: dza ya tsa shan ti/ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: satwaṃ bhā ya byer/ mo ha ya byer/ dzaṃ bha ya byer/ ya bzlog bh+yo: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ ma hā rid swāhā: ma hā de ba swāhā: mo mo pad swāhā: phra men gyis sbyor ba ngan pa las grol bar gyur cig: ti kra ma tsi ta nan/ badz+ra tshin+dha tshin+dha: shan ti shan ti/ shag byer de ba byer/ phra men gyi sbyor ba ngan pa mo ha byer: sbyor ba ngan pa bzlog bh+yo: dzi tsi ta shad ril thums rbad thums rbad/ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: mnan pa las grol bar gyur cig: dha ra bag sha ku kha kha/ kha pa 'u sha la/ na ta pa pa/ glad pa ta ku/ ma tsa lo ku ya/ bdag la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ oṃ ma hā a yu ta thums rbad/ dha hi ta hi ta ra/ pa sha ku sha kha khas/ nga kha 'u sha la na/ sa pa glad pa la/ ta ku ma tsa bdag la rak+ṣa: pra ma khrol: ya ma khrol: ya ma du tri khrol/ sa ma ya khrol/ du ru tri pa la shig khrol/ sa ma ya khrol/

ni la rad na khrol/ pad+ma rat+na ya ni khrol swāhā: ya ma ni khrol swāhā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: phra men gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha bag phye phye khrol khrol: ma ti 'ur pa phye phye khrol khrol: lce ti 'ur pa phye phye khrol khrol: tir te 'ur pa phye phye khrol khrol: 'ur ti 'ur pa phye phye khrol khrol: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ hri a badz+ra pa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa mnan pa thon thon: oṃ kā ya wāka khrol khrol: sa ma ya tsit+ta khrol khrol: pra be sha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa po ta ya gh+rig khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ban+dha tra tha phaṭa: bsdams pa khrol khrol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a bhi ṣīñca kā ya wāka tsit+ta hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ tig nan a mu ka ma ra ya phaṭa: oṃ gu ta na snas pa ta phu: tsa ta rbad ni phu graṃ: sha na pa no po ni swāhā: oṃ rak+ṣa nag po ban dgra'i srog la mā ra ya rbad sod: oṃ khrag rtsa rbad: snying khrag rbud: mā ra ya khas khas rbud rbud: oṃ thums thums nri sha thums ni ban dgra mā ra ya rbad sod thums thums: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭa: mkha' 'gros bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ ka li kā li mo hā li ye 'ur 'ur rgya 'ur: phu phu raṃ raṃ: nyil nyil/ srid gsum mgon po kham mi rgyu pi pi ling / khro chu phan phen: ga ga go dzi pa le/ gho sdam ri raṃ/ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ mar mer thab thig naṃ thong byer: gnam sa sdod byer: nyi zla stod char char 'byung ba'i dgra bzlog gshed kyi dug chings dmigs pa'i rten la bh+yo/ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ ma hā ka li phya brub brub: ma ma sngo ta keg ye swā hā:

na na dha ra dha ra phya brub brub: ma ma e e ye swāhā: e e ye phya brub brub: ma ma yaṃ yaṃ ye swāhā: yaṃ yaṃ ye phya brub brub: ma ma baṃ baṃ 'u ye swāhā: baṃ baṃ ye phya brub brub: ma ma raṃ raṃ dzi ye swāhā: raṃ raṃ ye phya brub brub: ma ma paṃ paṃ kur ye swāhā: paṃ paṃ ye phya brub brub: ma ma pu pu tang tang kur ye swāhā: ma ma ka ra ka ra shang ye swāhā: ma ma char chu'u ye swāhā: ma ma sngo ta sngo ta keg ye swāhā: 'byung ba lnga yis bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ khu khu ma shag pa bzlog: kha la tri bzlog: traṃ pu she'u bzlog: bha ta yan bzlog: khaṃ tig nan bzlog: phu sha he bzlog: ma mā ra ya bzlog: sha tsi yan bzlog: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa thams cad sarba a pa na ye swāhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wāka tsit+ta yak+ṣa: badz+ra tshin+dha tsa ha: shān+tiṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ shag byer: yar yar staṃ pa ya byer: mo ha byer: 'dzam bha byer: ya bzlog bh+yo: ban bon sngags pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pas mnan pa dang / bcings pa dang / bsdoms pa dang gzir ba dang ཿ byad du bcug pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol swāhā: gnod pa'i rigs thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā: phye phye khrol khrol: a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ a: ka kha ga gha nga : tsa tsha dza dzha nya: ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa: ta tha da dha na: pa pha ba bha ma:ya ra la wa: sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa: oṃ ye dharma he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣañca yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa swāhā: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la pha rol gyi mi dang mi ma yin pas bcings pa dang : mnan pa dang : bsdams pa dang : gzer ba dang byad du bcug pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: sarba a pa na ye swāhā: nad thams cad sarba a pa na ye swāhā: gdon thams cad sarba a pa na ye swāhā:

gdon bgegs rkyen ngan thams cad sarba a pa na ye swāhā: hūm̐/ khro bo'i rgyal po byad dang ngag 'grol ba rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag cag gi lus ngag yid gsum la pha rol mi dang mi ma yin pas bsam sbyor ngan pa dang / rnam par sdang ba dang / gnod par bsam pa dang / ngan sngags byed pa dang / byad du bcug pa dang / gtad khram byed pa dang / khram la 'debs pa dang / rbod gtong byed pa dang / sbyin sreg byed pa dang / ngag mnan pa dang / bcings pa dang / dmod mo byed pa dang / hom dang spar bu bskor ba dang / rlung gi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / steng lha yis bcings pa dang / 'og klu yis bcings pa dang / bar lha srin sde brgyad kyis bcings pa dang / phra men gyis byad du bcug nas lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa dang / mnan pa thams cad rnam par gzhig tu gsol/ rnam par 'jom du gsol/ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa thams cad khrol du gsol/ nges par khrol du gsol/ mthu byad kyis bcings pa thams cad sarba a pa na ye swāhā: lus bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ngag bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: yid bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bden pa dang / bar pa drang srong gi dmod pa dang / phyi pa mu stegs pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: mi nor zhing khang la gnod pa thams cad༞ dbang phyug chen po yab yum gyis bcings pa thams cad༞ gshin rje dang gshin rje mos༞ e ka dza ṭi dang ma mos bcings pa༞ bdud pho dang bdud mos༞ btsan dang rgyal pos༞ klu bdud dang klu mos༞ gnod sbyin dang gnod sbyin mos༞ gza' dang gdong mos bcings pa༞ yul lha dang yul 'dres༞ mu stegs pho mos bcings pa༞ srin po dang rmu yis bcings pa༞ rdo rje legs pa dang ther 'gong gis bcings pa༞ mgon po dang a phyis༞ yul 'dre pho mos༞ bgegs dang 'byung pos༞ mkha' 'gro dang shugs 'gros༞

hal khyi nag po 'khor dang bcas pas lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye༞ 'byung ba lngas༞ phra men gyi sbyor ba ngan pa phye phye༞ ngag mnan gyi sbyor ba ngan pa༞ gza' dang sde brgyad ming sring gi byad dang gtad khrol khrol༞ klu brgyad kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol༞ sde brgyad kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol༞ lus ngag yid gsum gyi byad dang gtad༞ shar nas klu sbrul mgo gsum pa'i byad dang gtad༞ lho nas klu sbrul mgo lnga pa'i༞ nub nas klu sbrul mgo bdun pa'i byad dang༞ byang nas klu sbrul mgo dgu pa'i༞ klu rgyal rigs kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol༞ klu rje rigs kyi༞ klu dmangs rigs kyi༞ klu bdud rigs kyi༞ klu bram ze'i byad dang༞ klu btsan gyi༞ klu gnyen rigs kyi byad dang gtad༞ klu srin rigs kyi༞ sa bdag 'dzin pos༞ sdom po khra bos༞ gyong sa zha bos༞ gza' klu sa bdag rje blon gyis byad dang gtad༞ gshin rje dang las gshin gyis༞ rgyal po dang rgyal 'gong༞ btsan dang ma mos༞ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa khrol: bsdams pa lhod/ mnan pa thegs/ zos pa skyugs/ shi ba gsos/ bsam sbyor ngan pa lhod/ lus kyi dbang po phye phye khrol khrol/ ngag gi dbang po phye phye khrol khrol/ yid kyi dbang po༞ bla bcings pa༞ rus bcings pa༞ ming bcings pa༞ gzugs bcings pa༞ kha rje dbang thang bcings pa༞ bsdoms pa dang bcings pa mnan pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ bsdams pa bcings pa mnan pa byad mthur bcug pa thams cad dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ gzungs ring gzungs thung rnams ji ltar nus pa bzla'o/ rgya gar skad nas khrol du gsol bar tshar gcig tad+ya thā nas rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad sarba a pa na ye swāhā bar gzungs ring yin pas gsum bdun nyer gcig sogs ci 'grub/ gzungs ring gi dbu'i tad+ya thā nas bhan+dha phaṭa swāhā bar gzungs thung yin pas brgya stong khri 'bum ci nus kyi grangs 'dzin byed/

sngags rdzogs pa'i hūm̐ khro bo'o rgyal po nas dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya phaṭa bar tshar gcig /thun bsdu ba ni/ snod bcud 'od zhu bdag nyid lhar thim zhing / /de yang hūm̐ yig la thim nā da'i bar/ /mi dmigs ngang gyur slar yang skad cig gis/ /snang stong sgyu ma khro rgyal sku ru gyur/ /zhes pas rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal zhing / slar yang dge ba bsngo ba sogs rjes kyi las rnams bya'o/ / bdag bskyed rkyang pa byed na de rjes dang / bum sgrub byed na mchod yon phul ba'i rjes dang / gzhan la byad 'grol byed na de rdzogs pa'i rjes su he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs nongs pa bzod gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs spyi 'gre byas mthar/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /rdo rje gtsug tor 'grub gyur nas sogs bsngo smon spyi 'gre'i mthar/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis gang shes bya'o/ /'di la rjes chog gzhan med gsungs pa 'dug kyang 'di tsam byas na mi 'gal zhing legs par sems so/ /gnyis pa gzhan don du bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'am min na rgyu skar rgyal dang ldan pa la/ rin po che la sogs pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gtsang zhing dag par bkrus la kha brgyan dang mgul 'ching sogs chas su gzhug rgyun 'babs kyi chu dang bar mar zal gyi 'o mas gzhi byas pa la/ ba dmar mo'i 'o ma dang chu blug bum pa'i rdzas ni/ rab gu ru yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar: med na sngags pa nus pa can dang : bud med rigs bzang mo dang : de gnyis kyi byang sems dkar dmar la bya'o: yang na rang gi de la bya'o: rdzas gu ru yab yum gyi byang sems bshad kyang deng sang chos sman gyi go chod/ li sug kha che ka ko la cu gang dzā ti/ gla tsi/ shin kun/ raṃ phye/ rgya tshwa/ phag dbugs ma chad tsam gyi sna/ shing nya brid/ g.yer ma 'bru bdun/ skyer pa 'bru dgu/ sha rwa'i phye ma/ ngang ser sha

sbrang rtsi rnams zhib tu bsnur ba'i phye ma btab/ stegs bu'i khar bum gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad dam tshom bu'i khar spos kyis bdug nas bkod/ de'i khar dung chos gzungs rdo rje dang bcas pa bzhag bgegs la gtor zlum/ de mdun du sbyin bdag gi glud gzugs/ mtheb kyu ril bu/ chang bu/ ting lo 'bar chog ma rnams snod gcig tu bshams pa/ sngags chu rin po che'i snod gang rung du chu gtsang la rin chen sna lnga brdar ba/ pho rog 'ug pa'i sgro gzhob btab/ gzhan yang / khrus sder/ sku dngos la khrus gsol mi thub na me long / gos zung dkar po/ mda' dar sna lnga me long btags pa/ mi grir bsad pa'i lcags las brdungs pa'i chu gri'i dbyibs can ra rog 'og can gyi ra spu/ med na gri lcags sam dkyus ma gang rigs/ ting lta bu'i snod so sor sa chu blug pa/ dpal 'bar/ rlung g.yab ljang gu yu ba can/ ba lu dang spen ma/ rma bya'i mdongs kyi phon pa/ 'om bu dang ku sha'i phon pa/ ku sha ma rnyed na ri klung gi 'jag ma gtsang ma/ sla ngar skyer pa'i drag hoṃ/ re ba gsum gyi gdan/ byad thag sngo dmar/ sats+tsha chag ro rab gnas zhig pa'am/ yang na bye ma btab pa sogs/ mkho ba'i yo byad mngon par 'dus bgyis la/ gtor ma dang mchod pa sogs sngar dang 'dra/ de nas bsgrub pa ni/ bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa song tshar ba'i rjes su/ bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ yig las byung ba'i/ /rin chen bum pa lto ldir mgrin pa phra/ /kha g.yel zhabs zhum mchu 'phyangs lha rdzas kyi/ /mgul ching dpag bsam shing gi kha brgyan can/ /mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs bdud rtsi'i chu gter dbus/ /pad nyi zla steng mthing nag hūm̐ yig las/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung rdo rje gtsug tor can/ /dbu stong rtsa zhal nyis brgya mthing nag rngam/ /zhes pa nas bstod pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin las/ bzlas pa'i tshe/ rang srog 'od kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la/ /'khril te bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs kar zhugs/

/de dag sku las ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs pas bum chur gnyis med ro gcig gyur/ /zhes pa 'di dmigs pa dang sbyar gzungs thag la 'jus nas gzungs dang gzungs thung gi bzlas pa ci nus bya zhing sngags chu la'ang phu 'debs/ de nas dung zhal gyi mchod yon 'bru gsum gyis bum par phul bas lha tshogs rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu bar bsam mo/ /skabs 'di dag tu gtor mgron spyan 'dren pa sogs lag len sna tshogs 'dug mod/ gsar ma'i rgyas 'gebs kyi spros pa las gzhung gi dgongs pa min pas rnying ma rang lugs la 'di tsam mo/ /de lta bu'i bum pa de nyid thog mar zhag bdun la sogs par ci nus bsgrub nas/ slar yang rgyal phur 'dzom pa'am rgyu skar rgyal la yang yang kha gso zhing rta ma chad par byas nas dus rgyun du 'khru zhing btung ba dang / gnas rten rnams la bsangs gtor la sogs pa byas na gzhung nas bshad pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung bar the tshom med do/ /las sbyor gyi byad 'grol byed par spro na/ rang gi mdun du bsgrub bya re nag gru gsum gyi khar bzhag gos nag bkon/ tshon skud kyis bcings/ mgul dang rkang lag gi srin mdzub/ sāts+tsha mgo bor bkod la 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /'o 'dir byad 'grol ba'i rim pa sgrub par byed pa las/ thog mar lo rgyus kyis/ nges shes bskyed pa dang cho ga dngos gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste/ rig 'dzin rje'i chog khrigs las/ byad kyi rtags rnams yong tshul dang / /gdams pa yid ches khung btsun brgyud/ /byad 'grol byas pa'i phan yon bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i dang po rtags ni/ gzhung las/ de yang rang la gzhan gyis ngag mnan pa dang / bcings pa dang / bsdoms pa dang / mthu byas pa'i rtags su/ lces lab mi shes par skrangs pa dang / lkog ma dang mgul pa 'gags nas na ba dang / sngags bgrang mi shes pa dang / bgrang yang sgra ma dag pa dang /

lce'i steng du mdog 'gyur ba dang / rgya gram du gas pa dang / kha bcings pa rmi ba dang / lce la phur pa btab pa rmi ba dang / chos pu ti 'og dang mchod rten gyi 'og tu non pa dang / dong gting ring du tshud pa rmi ba dang / re ba nag pos btum pa rmi ba dang / mun pa nag po'i phugs su tshud pa rmi ba dang / brag phug stong pa dang / khang stong yul stong rmi ba dang / gcig nas gcig tu 'dzul ba rmi ba dang / khang stong ldib la khad pa'i nang du phyin pa rmi ba dang / zam pa dang lam rgya gram gyi dkyil du nyal ba rmi ba dang / ri rong dog mo'i rtse nas rbab tu ltung la khad pa dang / lhungs ba rmi ba dang / lha khang dang lder bzo rmi ba dang / dngos su'ang rang nyams shed chung ba dang / sngags bzla snying mi 'dod pa dang / bzlas kyang ldab ldib tu song ba dang : bsgrubs pa byas kyang nus pa chung la bar chad mang ba dang : rang khro zhing tshig pa za ba dang : snying mi dga' ba dang : bskyed rim mi gsal ba dang : lus lci zhing 'thib pa dang : gos mi gtsang ba gyon pa dang : mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab du phyin pa dang : ro khur ba'i gling du phyin pa dang : nad pa skyugs log rmi ba dang : mtsho dang chu rlan rlon gyi 'dam du bying ba dang : phyin pa rmi ba dang : grog pa chen po me'i 'og tu tshud pa dang : khyer la khad pa dang : ri nyil ba dang : brag khung gting ring du 'dzul ba rmi ba dang : dngos su'ang shes pa gnad du mi pheb par yed yed pa dang : lus ngag yid gsum mnan pa dang bcings pa dang : bsdams pa lta bu dang : nang 'thab mang ba dang : rmi lam du mi ngo mi shes pa dang : mon pa dang : a tsa ras brgyab pa dang 'thab pa rdo char dang thog 'babs pa rmi ba dang : mda' dang mdung dang gri brgyab pa rmi ba dang : rlung nag 'tshub pa dang ri gzar nas rbab byung ba rmi ba dang : dmag mang po dang ban+dhe dang sngags bon gyi dmag gis bskor ba rmi ba dang : gcan gzan dang bya nag gis ded pa rmi ba dang :

dngos su rang gi gos la rma byung ba dang : ltas ngan gyi sems can byung ba dang : bud med dang mi mang pos mdzo dang rta dang bong sogs la sga stong pa gtad nas rang la sgo nyal byed pa dang : rtags de rnams tshur la byung na mis rang la byas pa'i rtags so: de rnams ni mthu byad yod pa'i rtags so: zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhung las/ sngon rgya gar gyi yul du las kyi mkha' 'gros mdzad do: rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su mchod rten sngon po'i khri 'phang la sbas so: rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod la slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po byon nas tshogs kyi dgongs pa mdzad kyin yod tsa na: mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung nas/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs kyi mchod rten sngon po'i khri 'phang la gsang sngags rnams kyi nus pa nyams pa gso ba dang : man ngag mkhan rnams kyi nus pa med par bya ba dang / rang gi nus pa thams cad mchog tu bskyed pa'i gdams pa yod do: zhes lung bstan byung nas: der slob dpon gyis gzigs pas byang phyogs kyi mchod rten de'i khri 'phang la me stag dmar khrom khrom 'dug pa gzigs nas der mkha' 'gro la gtor ma phul nas: de la gzong gis g.yengs pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig byung ngo : de gshig pa'i nang nas gsang ba'i man ngag gsang sngags nus pa gso ba'i man ngag nus pa thams cad mchog tu bskyed pa'i man ngag 'di byung ngo : der slob dpon thugs dgyes te mkha' 'gro rnams la gtor tshogs rgya chen po phul lo: slob dpon khrag 'thung nag pos gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes la gnang ngo : de nas rim par drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa ni gang las byung ba'i lo rgyus so: gsum pa phan yon ni gzhung las de ltar byas pas ban bon sngags pa mu stegs 'bum gyis mthu gtad ser gsum/ phra men gyi ngan sbyor/ 'gong chog ngan sngags kyis rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa kha rje dbang thang lus ngag yid gsum mnan pa thams cad skad cig nyid la grol te yon tan dang phan yon dpag tu med do:

rang gi chos skyong gi rten la gtor na rang gi srung ma bdud du babs pa las grol bar 'gyur: zhing la gtor na zhing sel byas pa thams cad grol: khang pa la gtor na khang sel gyis mi tshugs: sngags rnams rin po ches bris rdza'i ga 'ur bcug nas khang pa dang zhing la sbas na bkra shis shing : ye shes pa dang bsrung ma ngang gis 'du'o/ /mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul che: bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro: 'di nyid rdzong dang khang pa gnas gzhi gang du byas pa der/ khang sel khang gtad mthu byad mnan gtad khram gsum gyis mi tshugs te gnas khang bkra shis la byin che: lha dang srung ma 'du'o: zhing la zhing sel ngan byed gnod pas mi tshugs shing btsa' sad 'bu srin gyis mi tshugs: lo legs par 'gyur ro: rnal 'byor pa rang dang dpon slob gang yod pa thams cad kyi mthu byad mnan gtad khram gsum gyi ngan sbyor thams cad nyi ma la ba mo zhu ba ltar gyur pa dang : sdig sgrib dag rig pa dwangs: bskyed rim gsal: dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel: bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro: de la sogs pa phan yon bgrang las 'das so: de bzhin du ri la gtor na ri bkra ngan pa thams cad zhi zhing tsā legs: slas la gtor na phyugs 'phel ba dang god kha chad de bkra shis par 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs so: gnyis pa byad 'grol gyi cho ga dngos la/ rnam gsum gsal btab bgegs gtor gtong : 'byung bzhi'i nyon mongs bgegs sbyangs shing : byad 'grol me lhar byad thag 'bul: sngags chus 'khru zhing me la 'gong : gdan rjes byab rdzas gsum gyis byabs: khrus dngos gzungs ring chen mo dang : gzungs chung bzla zhing bum chu'i 'khru: bsrung 'khor bde legs shis brjod brgyad: zhes pa'i dang po/ bsgrub bya gsal gdab cing bgegs gtor gtong ba ni: de yang byad 'grol ba'i gzhi ni/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum yin la/ gang dgrol bar bya ba ni/ ban bon sngags pa'i mthu byad kyis bcings pa/

'grol byed ni gdam pa zab mo 'di'o/ /de yang dgrol bya'i rnam pa gsal 'debs tsam yin pas 'di ltar bsgom mdzod: da lta khyed rang pha rol gyis byad khar bcings te yod pa'i tshul du lcags khang gru gsum par tshud cing sbrul sngo dmar gyis bcings pa dang / mchod rten nag pos mnan pas 'khyog 'gul mi shes par mnan pa'i tshul mdzod: de yang byad de 'grol ba byed pa la/ spyir mthun rkyen thams cad la bar du gcod cing mi 'dod pa'i rkyen ngan thams cad sna 'dren pa ni bgegs yin pas de la gtor ma byin nas bskrad par bya ba yin te/ bgegs gtor bsham pa la bsangs chu bran nas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'dod yon du byin gyis brlabs bgegs rnams oṃ badz+ra a kar+ṣa ya dzas bkug sarba bighā nān bh+yo sogs gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐ steng 'og phyogs mtshams skyong byed pa'i/ /lha klu gnod sbyin nam mkha' lding / /dri za srin po mi'am ci/ /'byung po gnod bgegs lan chags rnams/ /gtor ma mar me mtheb kyu dang / /chang bu glud bzang 'di khyer la/ /tshe sngon mnar ba'i lan chags dang / /rkyen gyur glo bur 'tshe ba rnams/ /khro rgyal chen po'i bka' bzhin du/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /lan chags bu lon sha 'khon khyer/ /'di nas dpag tshad brgyad khri na/ /lho phyogs gshin thang nag po na/ /gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po yis/ /las kyi dkar nag chos bshad kyi/ /khyod kyi chos skal de ru nyon/ /mi 'gro slar yang gnod sems na/ /khro rgyal 'bar ba rab khros nas/ /lus ngag thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlog /gtor ma phyir skyel/ drag sngags ci shes dang hūm̐ bzhi pa bzla zhing thun brab dang gu gul gyis bgegs bskrad/ gnyis pa phyi 'byung ba bzhi'i byad spyir 'grol ba ni/ khyed rang gi lus 'di 'byung ba bzhi las grub pa yin pas de la phyi rol gyi 'byung ba'i dwangs ma rnams stobs su smin na mthun rkyen byed la/

gshed du babs na 'gal rkyen byed de/ de yang pha rol pos las sbyor byas pa'i mtha' 'byung ba bzhi gang rung la gtad pa las mi 'da' bas/ de'i nyes pa sbyang ba'i phyir 'byung ba'i dug sbyong ba ste/ hūm̐ḥ rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas nas/ /sku gsum ting 'dzin las grub pa'i/ /sngags pa las kyi nus stobs kyis/ /gnyen po'i lha srung bskyed pa dang / /'phrin las pho nya'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin drag po'i rdzas/ /lo zla gza' skar dus tshod dang / /rgyu dus thebs bzlog sa bdag dang / /gdong thug gtad bcug nyes pa dang / /stong nyid nam mkha'i dmigs sbyor gyis/ /sa yi 'og tu mnan pa dang / /'byung ba chu la gtad pa dang / /drag po'i sbyin sreg me yi las/ /phra men rlung la bskor ba dang / /dgra gshed nang 'khrugs sbyor ba yis/ /rang gis phar byas log pa rnams/ /rdzas sngags nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa thams cad zhi gyur cig /ces 'byung ba'i dug spyir sbyangs nas/ de nas 'byung ba so sos khyad par du byad 'grol ba ni/ pha rol gyis 'byung ba sa la mnan pa byas pas byad du gyur pa thams cad khyed rang gi lus las thon pa la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sa ni sra mkhregs rang bzhin te/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang thams cad sbyangs/ /me long ye shes gsal gyur cig /laṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swāhā/ 'byung ba chu la gtad pa'i byad du gyur pa thams cad khyed rang gi lus las thon chu la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ chu ni rlan zhing gsher ba ste/ /nyon mongs nga rgyal thams cad sbyangs/ /mnyam nyid ye shes gsal gyur cig /baṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swāhā/ 'byung ba me la sbyin sreg byas pas byad du gyur pa thams cad khyed rang gi lus las thon me la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me ni tsha zhing bsreg pa ste/ /nyon mongs 'dod chags thams cad sbyangs/ /sor rtog ye shes gsal gyur cig /raṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swāhā/

'byung ba rlung la 'khor lo bskor bas byad du gyur pa thams cad khyed rang gi lus las thon rlung la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rlung ni yang zhing g.yo ba ste/ /nyon mongs phrag dog thams cad sbyangs/ /bya grub ye shes gsal gyur cig /yaṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swāhā/ stong nyid nam mkha'i dmigs sbyor gyis bcings pas byad du gyur pa thams cad dmigs med nam mkha'i rang bzhin du dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ nam mkha' kun khyab rang bzhin can/ /nyon mongs gti mug thams cad sbyangs/ /chos dbyings ye shes gsal gyur cig /e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swāhā/ des phyi 'byung ba lnga yi dug sbyang ba sogs/ de nas nang nyon mongs pa lnga'i byad 'grol ba ni/ de yang dper na/ khab len gyi rdos lcags sdud pa bzhin khyed rang gi rgyud las nyon mongs kyi sgrib pa dang ldan par byad kha sogs 'gal rkyen thams cad shugs la 'du bas sdig sgrib sbyong ba gal che/ des na khyed rang tha mal du gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ de ltar gsal btab nas tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bshags pa dang / phyin chad mi bgyid snyam pa'i dam bca' brtan pos yig brgya dang snying po 'di nyid bzlas pas sku las byung ba'i byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis sdig sgrib thams cad nag nur gyis sbyong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes ci nus su bzlas mthar/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/

/'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad mthol zhing bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes de ltar mos dung gis gsol ba btab pa rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsum pa byad 'grol zhing byad thag dmigs byar gsal ba me lhar 'bul ba ni/ gri lcags las grub pa'i chu gri ra rog 'og can gyi rwas yu ba byas pa thogs la/ slob dpon khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor du gsal ba'i phyag na ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba bsnams pas khyed rang gi lus la bcings pa'i byad thag 'di nyid bcad pas bcings pa'i nyes pa thams cad la grol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid khro rgyal gtsug tor gyis/ /phyag na ye shes ral gri bsnams/ /tshe sngon las ngan las grub pa'i/ /nad dang gdon dang rigs sngags byad/ /pha rol mi dang mi min gyis/ /dngos su bsam sbyor ngan pa dang / /lkog tu bsam pa dug g.yos dang / phra men gtad khram 'gong chog dang / /khang sel zhing sel du rlung dang / /hoṃ dang spar bu bskor ba dang / /byad du bcug cing ngag mnan pa/ /mi mthun sbyor ba'i dug rnams kun/ /gcod byed ral gri me 'bar bas/ /thams cad dum bur gtubs nas kyang / /ye shes me lha'i zhal du 'bul/ /sho dang khram la btab pa rnams/ /gnam lcags ral gri 'bar bas bcad/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas bcad/ /oṃ ka ya k+ṣa ya/ badz+ra tshin+dha tshin+dha/ shin+ta shin+ta shag byer/ yar yar staṃ bha ya byer/ dzam+bha ya byer/ mo ha ya byer/ ya bzlog bh+yoḥ āḥwāka k+ṣa ya/ badz+ra tshin+dha tshin+dha/ shin+ta shin+ta shag byer/ yar yar staṃ bha ya byer/ dzam+bha ya byer/ mo ha ya byer/ ya bzlog bh+yoḥ hūm̐ tsit+ta kā ya badz+ra dzi han/ badz+ra tshin+dha tshin+dha/ shin+ta shin+ta shag byer/ yar yar staṃ bha ya byer/ dzam+bha ya byer/

mo ha ya byer/ ya bzlog bh+yoḥ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bhi sha dhe/ bhi sha dhe/ bhai ra bhai raḥ badz+ra dha ra ṇiḥ bhan+dha bhan+dha ni/ badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ bhan+dha bhan+dha phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla bzhin par byad thag 'grol zhing gcod do/ /de nas dmigs bya me lhar 'bul ba las thab dang / me lha gsal gdab pa ni/ lcags slang la sogs pa'i snod du skyer shing sogs drag po'i shig gi nam gru gsum du brtsigs pa de mdun du bshams la/ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing me spar/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes rlung g.yab kyis me gsos nas/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i/ /drag po'i thab khung gru gsum mtshan nyid kun/ /yongs rdzogs nang du raṃ las bskal pa'i me/ /'bar dbus pad nyir mthing nag yi ge hūm̐/ /de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas sras bcas mchod/ /phas rgol rigs sngags dmod pa'i sbyor ba bshig /byin rlabs dngos grub dwangs bcud hūm̐ la thim/ /de nyid yongs gyur pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /me lha khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor can/ /dbu stong rtsa zhal nyis brgya mthing nag rngam/ /g.yas zhal nyis brgya gser mdog 'dzum nyams rgyas/ /rgyab zhal nyis brgya dmar po chags pa'i nyams/ /g.yon zhal nyis brgya ljang gu gtum pa'i tshul/ /steng zhal nyis brgya dkar po bzhad pa'i zhal/ /stong phrag phyag ldan bye ba phrag brgya'i spyan/ /dmar zlum sdang mig phyogs bcu kun tu blta/ /rdzi smin ag tshom dmar ser me ltar 'bar/ /zhal gdangs ya so hūm̐ las khro bo bcu/ /ma so hrīḥlas khro mo bcu ru gtsigs/ /mgrin pa nyi zla lce ni gcod byed kyi/ /rno ngar ral gri 'bar ba'i rnam par gdengs/ /stong phrag phyag na gnam lcags ral gri bsnams/ /thod skam dbu brgyan zhing glang stod g.yogs dang / /stag sham mgo phreng dur khrod rgyan chas brjid/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'dor stabs drag por bsgrad/

/gar dgu'i nyams rgyas dbang sngon lhun po la/ /nyi ma stong gi 'khyud bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs/ /de yi spyi bor zla steng oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar aḥ snying khar nyi dkyil hūm̐ sngon mtshan pa las/ 'od 'phros rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs bskul/ /spyan drangs yi ge gsum la thim pa yis/ /rim bzhin rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin/ /snang mtha' dmar po g.yas pa pad+ma 'dzin/ /mi bskyod mthing kha g.yas pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun kyang g.yon pa dril 'dzin longs sku'i chas/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/ /de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las/ /'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs gyur/ /spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ dmigs med mkha' ltar khyab cing dag pa'i sku/ /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba mi dmigs kyang / /thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos sku dag pa las/ /ye shes sgyu mar rol phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /dam tshig bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar dang / ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta༞ ma hā ba ling+ta༞ zhes mchod do/ /bstod pa bya ba ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i rnam rol las/ /rig sngags dmod pa phyir bzlog drag po'i lhar/ /rnam rol rdo rje khrag 'thung gtsug tor can/ /'jigs byed 'jigs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes bstod/ byad thag bcad pa dmigs rten du byas la/ na mo rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ gsang sngags dang /

rig sngags dang / gzungs sngags dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang / chos nyid gdod nas stong kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / khyad par bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas pha rol gyi rig sngags mkhan gyi byad phur rbod gtong bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi nus pa thams cad dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig snying po'i sngags tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le sogs/ mthar a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod/ khro rgyal 'khor bcas gnam sa lta bu'i zhal gdangs nas gnod byed thams cad gsol bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam nas sde brgyad byad thag bcad nas kyang / byad thag 'bul tshig dang bstun nas rim pas me la 'bul/ drag po me lha'i zhal du 'bul/ /yungs zor tshe zor dz+wa la raṃ/ /gshin rje'i 'khor lo dz+wa la raṃ/ /gza' yi king kang dz+wa la raṃ/ /gnod byed gdug rtsub༞ /lha chad rdo 'bebs༞ mu stegs bar chad༞ ma mo'i khrag zor༞ bdud kyi khram 'debs༞ rgyal po'i thog rgyug༞ srin pos za res༞ ltas ngan brgyad cu༞ ye 'drog sum brgya༞ bram ze'i tshe rku༞ bdud kyi nang 'thab༞ ban+dhe'i sngags zor༞ bon po'i gtso dmar dz+wa la raṃ/ sho la thebs pa sho kha bsgyur/ khram la btab pa khram kha bsgyur/ gdon bgegs log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma rungs gdug pa tshar bcad nas/ /drag po'i lha tshogs zhal du 'bul/ /zhes brjod cing lhag ma ma lus par 'bul lo/ /de nas me lhar mchod bstod byas nas/ ye shes pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa mer 'bar bar gyur/ bzhi pa byad bkru zhing me la 'gong pas byad phur bsregs pa ni las sbyor gyi sngags chu sgro gzhob can gyi bum chu thogs la/ de yang sngags kyi bskol ba'i chu 'di nyid kyis khyed rang gi spyi bo nas blugs pas thog mar spyi bor gnod byed kyi mchod rten nag po de bye ma'i mkhar chus bshig pa bzhin sbyangs nas mthar khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i nyes skyon thams cad bkrus shing sbyangs pas dri ma med pa'i shel ltar dag cing gtsang bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

thog mar bum chus kha bshal nas phyir dor/ de nas khog tu gtong slar spyi bor lugs bzhin par sāts+tsha nyid bshig par bya'o/ /hūm̐ dkon mchog bden pa'i thugs rje dang / /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags mthus/ /rten 'brel rdzas kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rnam dag lha yi chu rgyun dang / /rmad byung ye shes bdud rtsi 'dis/ /las dang nyon mongs bag chags dang / /nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus 'khru/ /pho rgyud rnams kyi che btsan pa/ /dbang phyug chen pos bcings pa 'khru/ /mo rgyud rnams kyi tshe btsan pa/ /u ma de wis bcings pa 'khru/ /dgra srog 'khor los gcod pa'i phyir/ /gshin rje yab yum༞ /ma tshogs dgra la dbab pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i rgyal mos byin brlabs kyis/ /gsang sngags bstan pa srung mdzad ma/ /sngags srung chen mos byin brlabs kyis/ /dgra la bdud dmag dbab mdzad pa'i/ /bdud dmag yab yum bcings pa 'khru/ /ltas ngan cho 'phrul mnga' bdag ste/ /rgyal pos bcings pa༞ /smyo 'bog cho 'phrul mnga' ba ste/ /srog bdag tshangs pas༞ /sprul pa sna tshogs ston mdzad pa'i/ /dgra lhas bcings pa༞ /dgra snying zas su za mdzad pa'i/ rak+ṣa glog phreng༞ /dgra khrag skam du 'thung mdzad pa'i/ /sbal mgo khrag mig༞ /dgra snying zas su rol mdzad pa'i/ /yak+ṣa me dbal༞ /bstan pa'i bar chad sgrol mdzad pa'i/ /ma hā kā las bcings༞ /dam las 'das pa bsgral ba'i phyir/ /ru tras bcings pa༞ /dgra sdang khram la dbab mdzad pa'i/ /dmu yis bcings pa༞ /log lta bar chad 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /gu lang nag pos bcings pa༞ /bar chad 'gong po 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /lha rabs sham pos༞ /mngon shes gtan la dbab mdzad pa'i/ /thog gi bu yug༞ /zas nor dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ /the rang bcings༞ /dgra la gri 'thab gtong mdzad pa'i/ /btsan rgod rnams kyis bcings pa༞ /dgra la phung brdal gtong byed pa'i/ bi na ya kas༞ /dgra la phung gsum gtong byed pa'i/

/yam shud dmar pos bcings pa༞ /dgra bo thun gyis bsad mdzad pa'i/ /mgyogs byed nag pos༞ /dgra la klu nad btang ba'i phyir/ /klu bdud mgo dgus bcings༞ /dgra la mdze nad gtong ba'i phyir/ /yak+ṣa nag mos༞ /de la sogs te lha srin gyi/ /gtad khram mnan gzer thams cad 'khru/ /phyi khrus dung las dkar ba dang / /nang khrus mchong las dmar gyur cig /byad ltems nyes tshogs byang gyur cig /oṃ kā ya k+ṣa ya badz+ra tshin+dha tshin+dha/ shin+ta shin+ta shag byer/ yar yar staṃ bha ya byer/ dzaṃ bha ya byer/ mo ha ya byer/ ya bzlog bh+yoḥ āḥwāka k+ṣa ya/ badz+ra tshin+dha tshin+dha/ shin+ta shin+ta shag byer/ yar yar staṃ bha ya byer/ dzaṃ bha ya byer/ mo ha ya byer/ ya bzlog bh+yoḥ hūm̐ tsit+ta k+ṣa ya/ badz+ra dzi han/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ shan+ti shin+ta shag byer/ yar yar staṃ bha ya byer/ dzaṃ bha ya byer/ mo ha ya byer/ ya bzlog bh+yoḥ zhes khrus chus rgyun ma chad par bkru'o/ /byad phur bsregs pa ni/ de nas me la phan tshun du lan bdun 'gem pa'i tshe ye shes kyi me lces khyed rang gi lus la gnas pa'i byad kha phur kha/ chag che nyam nga thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sku gsung thugs sngags oṃ kā ya sogs/ bzla zhing / bsgrub bya me la lan bdun 'gom du bcug me la mchongs pa tsam gyis byad dang gtad khram las grol bar bsam mo/ /de nas re ba'i gdan dor gdan dkar por 'bru tshom bkod pa'i khar gos gsar pa bkon la bzhag go /lnga pa byabs rdzas rim pa gsum gyis byabs pa las/ byabs rdzas dang pos byabs pa ni/ /ba lu spe'u lcug ma rma bya'i mdongs rnams rdo rje'i thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung la/ 'o byabs rdzas 'di nyid kyis khyed rang gi lus la byabs pa tsam gyis byad phur nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sbur ma rlung gis bsdus pa ltar phyag nas me la sprugs te rjes med du bsreg pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ bdud rtsi can gyi shing bu 'di/

/ba lus bu yi tshul du byas/ /spe'u shing gi ma tshan de/ /ma yi rang bzhin dag tu byas/ /ma bu sdebs pa'i lcug ma la/ /mdongs ldan rma bya'i sgro yis brgyan/ /grib dang nad gdon rig sngags byad/ /pha rol rbod gtong drag po dang / /gtad sel rlung gi sbyor ngan pa/ /phra men cho 'phrul ngan pa sogs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /rten 'brel rdzas kyi nus pa yis/ /nyes skyon log pa'i sbyor ba rnams/ /me long phyis bzhin byang gyur cig /steng phyogs lha yi bcings pa byabs/ / byabs tshig dang bstun me'i steng du 'phyong tshul bya/ shar phyogs dri zas༞ /shar lho me lhas༞ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i༞ /lho nub srin pos༞ /nub phyogs chu lhas༞ /nub byang rlung lhas༞ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin༞ /byang shar dbang ldan༞ /steng phyogs lha dbang bcings pa༞ /'og phyogs klu dbang༞ /byabs pa thams cad byang gyur cig /gdon bgegs log 'dren 'byung po rnams/ /don la smra bsam brjod med yin/ /rang sems 'pho 'gyur bral ba 'dis/ /'khor 'das gnyis med chos kyi sku/ /chos nyid rang so zin gyur cig /sku gsung thugs kyi snying po brjod/ /byabs rdzas gnyis pas byabs pa ni/ /sngar bzhin byabs rdzas 'om bu ku sha 'jag ma rnams thogs la dmigs pa spo/ hūm̐ gtsang zhing gtsang ma 'om bu shing / /thabs kyi rang bzhin tshul du byas/ /ku sha byang chub bskyed pa'i gdan/ /'jag ma shes rab rang bzhin te/ /thabs shes tshul du byabs pa 'dis/ /de ring 'dir tshogs bdag bcas kyi/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /srog lus dbang thang rlung rta la/ /lha srin sde brgyad gdong thug dang / /gtad khram gdong dang mi gtsang grib/ /glo bur ye 'drog mi mthun byabs/ / sngar bzhin me'i steng du 'phyong tshul bya/ ma mos bcings pa thams cad byabs/ /bdud kyis bcings pa thams cad byabs/ /gnod sbyin༞ /gza' yis༞ /rgyal pos bcings༞

/btsan gyis༞ /klu yis༞ /dmu yis༞ /rdo rje legs pas bcings pa byabs/ /byabs pas nyes tshogs 'dzin rtog zhi/ /zung 'jug sku bzhi mngon gyur shog /sku gsung thugs kyi snying po brjod/ /byabs rdzas gsum pa mda' dar gyis byabs pa ni/ de yang mda' la btags pa'i dar tshon sna lnga po 'di nyid rgyal ba rigs lnga'i skur gsal ba'i so so'i sku las dri ma med pa'i 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang mthing kha'i tshul du khyed rang gi rgyud la gnas pa'i dug lnga'i nyes tshogs thams cad sbyangs nas ye shes lngar rgyas btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ smyug ma chos nyid stong pa la/ /sgro ni sku gsung thugs kyi rtags/ /stong ni thabs dang shes rab tshul/ /mde'u chos sku nyag gcig rtags/ /rten 'brel thabs kyi mda' bzang la/ /shes rab stong gsal me long brgyan/ /ye shes lnga mtshon dar gyis spras/ /mda' dar mthing kha rnam snang gsal/ /nyon mongs gti mug thams cad byabs/ / sngar bzhin me'i steng du 'phyong tshul bya/ chos dbyings ye shes gsal gyur cig /mda' dar dkar po rdor sems gsal/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang thams cad byabs/ /me long ye shes gsal gyur cig /mda' dar ser po rin 'byung gsal/ /nyon mongs nga rgyal thams cad byabs/ /mnyam nyid ye shes gsal gyur cig /mda' dar dmar po snang mtha' yas/ /nyon mongs 'dod chags༞ /sor rtog ye shes gsal gyur༞ /mda' dar ljang gu don grub gsal/ /nyon mongs phrag dog thams cad byabs/ /bya grub ye shes gsal gyur cig /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dag /nga rgyal phrag dog las gyur pa'i/ /rtogs na ye shes rang bzhin yin/ /ma rtogs dug lnga rang rgyud pa/ /dug lnga'i rang mdangs dgra bgegs rnams/ /ye shes lnga ru lhun grub nas/ /chos nyid rang sa zin gyur cig /sku gsung thugs kyi snying po brjod/ /drug pa khrus dngos ni/ thog mar rten byin can gyi snang brnyan shar ba'i me long la khrus gsol te/

hūm̐/ sngon tshe sangs rgyas sku bltams tshe/ /brgya byin la sogs lha rnams dang / /bkra shis lha mos glur bcas nas/ /dag pa'i sku khrus gsol ba bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta th+wa ga ta a bhi ṣe ka tā sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ nyon mongs sgrib pa rnam sbyong ba/ /ye shes chen pos khrus byas pa'i/ /dug lnga'i rang rgyud rnams sbyangs nas/ /ye shes lnga ru lhun grub shog /srab 'jam kha dog rnams legs pa/ /dri bzang snying po'i rab bkod pas/ /rnam rtog yid kyi gzugs can phyi/ /ma rig 'khrul pa dag gyur cig /oṃ aḥhūm̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe swāhā/ zhes dar dkar pos phyi ba'i tshul bya/ khrus chu de slar bum par blugs la/ slob dpon khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor du gsal ba'i phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu bos gang ba'i khrus gsol ba tsam gyis byad kha phur kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong sdebs shor rlung 'khor dbye bskrad rmongs pa sogs kyis bskyed pa'i nad gdon chag che nyam nga la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bum chu rgyun mi chad par spyi bo nas blug cing / slob dpon gyis gzungs rnams brjod cing las rdor gyis bum chu bsgrub bya'i spyi bo nas blugs la 'khru ba phyag len no// lus thams cad 'khru'o/ /gzungs ring chen mo ni/ rgya gar skad du/ bha ra u sha tsakra nā ma/ bod skad du/ ngag 'grol ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐/ rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo nas/ mjug bar chad thams cad sarba a pa na ye swāhā yan gyis 'khru/ slar yang sngar bzhin bum chu blugs bzhin par 'khru/ 'di nyid bzla ste/ gzungs chung ni/ hūm̐ khro bo'i rgyal po byad dang ngag 'grol ba rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa nas/ bsdoms pa bcings pa mnan pa byad mthur bcug pa thams cad dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/

zhes brjod cing bkru'o/ /bdun pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ bsgrub bya la bum chu 'thor zhing / a mṛ ta dang swa bha was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen po'i skur gsal ba'i spyi bor bud+dha he ru ka mgrin par pad+ma he ru ka thugs kar badz+ra he ruka lte bar rat+na he ru ka gsang bar karma he ru ka rnams gsal bar gyur/ slar yang spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ gnas lnga'i rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas lus rdo rje'i go khrab kyis zhu lubs su g.yogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ badz+ra rdo rje gnas gsum du reg kā ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ badz+ra wāk+ka rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ badz+ra tsit+ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ zhes brjod/ brgyad pa bde legs dang shis brjod bya ba ni/ me tog 'thor zhing / hūm̐/ byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing / /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing / /thub pa'i snyan pas gang gyur des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing / /chos kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ /khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa lha rnams dang / /lhar bcas kun gyi bde legs shing / /khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sems can byad las rab grol zhing / /nus pa mchog dang ldan gyur cig /oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrī āḥ shis brjod ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rnam rgyas 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/

/de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs mdzod/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab g.yo med pa/ /'jig rten gsum na grags zhes lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /dam chos ldan pa thos pa'i bkra shis kyis phyug cing / /dge 'dun mi dang lha dang lha min yon gyi gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs mdzod/ /zhes bkra shis kyi rim pas bde legs su bya'o/ /'di la rjes chog gzhan med cing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /byad 'grol gser gyi lde mig ces/ /kun la grags pa gsal ldan yang / /rtsa ba'i khungs dang lha sngags kyang / /ma shes 'chol bar spyod pa mthong / /des na snying po'i yi ge 'di/ /mthong bas dang po'i las can kyang / /rmongs pa med pa gnas thob 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di yang man ngag go /zhes rnying lugs kyi byad 'grol nag 'gros ma 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos smin gling phyag len gtso bor bzung der mi gsal ba rnams byang lugs nas cung zad kha bskang ste rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas phyogs gcig brdebs pa 'di la 'ol tshod rtog bzo'i dri ma phra mo tsam yang med pas shin tu yid ches pa'i gnas yin no// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ byad 'grol gser lde'i chog khrid/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
